results.name: AutoFilter list hides rows (SUBTOTAL 9 and 109 skip them), Hide rows hides by hand (only 109 skips), arrows skip hidden rows; Save → openpyxl sees hidden rows + the filter; Unhide shows hand-hidden rows only; Clear shows the rest
modal shortcut: with the filter list open, typing, Delete, Backspace, Ctrl+V / Z / X never edit the cell behind it; Escape closes the list and the grid has the keyboard again
Export CSV: the dialog lists what CSV drops; OK downloads the displayed text of the used range; Cancel downloads nothing; Import CSV adds a typed sheet and keeps =… as text
Writer: Export Markdown downloads heading / bold / list Markdown after the loss dialog; From Markdown opens a new document with the converted heading and list
Slides: Outline downloads the deck's titles, bullets and notes as Markdown after the loss dialog
no page errors during the suite
